intro: Discover Nerja on the eastern Costa del Sol: the Balcón de Europa, Burriana Beach, the famous caves and the whitewashed village of Frigiliana nearby. Plan your holiday and keep your memorable visits and photos on your device.

areas.name: Nerja Old Town
areas.description: Walk the historic centre, tapas streets and small squares around the Balcón de Europa.

areas.name: Balcón de Europa
areas.description: Central viewpoint overlooking the Mediterranean and nearby coves.

areas.name: Burriana
areas.description: Popular beach neighbourhood with restaurants and watersports.

areas.name: Maro
areas.description: Small village east of Nerja, close to coves and the Nerja Caves.

areas.name: Punta Lara
areas.description: Residential area west of the centre, with hillside views.

areas.name: Frigiliana
areas.description: Nearby whitewashed hill village with steep cobbled lanes and scenic viewpoints.

attractions.name: Balcón de Europa
attractions.description: Seafront viewpoint and promenade in the heart of Nerja.

attractions.name: Nerja Caves (Cueva de Nerja)
attractions.description: Large cave system near Maro; check official opening hours and book ahead if needed.

attractions.name: Nerja Museum
attractions.description: Local history museum in the town centre.

attractions.name: El Salvador Church
attractions.description: Church near the Balcón de Europa.

attractions.name: Frigiliana Old Town
attractions.description: Picturesque nearby hill village with narrow streets and viewpoints.

attractions.name: Acueducto del Águila
attractions.description: Historic aqueduct near Maro; view safely from designated areas.

transport.name: Málaga Airport
transport.description: Nearest major airport; plan onward travel by bus, taxi or transfer.

transport.name: Intercity buses
transport.description: ALSA operates routes in the region; confirm stops and timetables.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current services around Nerja and nearby villages.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm fares for longer trips.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: The town centre is walkable, but many routes include hills and steps.

transport.name: Driving
transport.description: Parking near beaches and central streets can be limited in peak season.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check bank and card charges.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government advice and passport entry requirements before travelling.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is spoken in many tourist businesses.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow flags, lifeguard instructions and local swimming restrictions.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is normally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Local terrain
useful.description: Nerja and Frigiliana have hills, steps and cobbled streets; plan accessibility.

beaches.name: Burriana Beach
beaches.description: Large sandy beach with facilities, chiringuitos and watersports.

beaches.name: Calahonda Beach
beaches.description: Small cove reached by steps near the Balcón de Europa.

beaches.name: El Salón Beach
beaches.description: Compact central beach below the old town.

beaches.name: Carabeillo Beach
beaches.description: Smaller cove with steps and limited facilities.

beaches.name: Playa de Maro
beaches.description: Scenic cove near Maro; access and parking can be restricted.

beaches.name: Torrecilla Beach
beaches.description: Accessible town beach west of the centre with a promenade.

markets.name: Nerja weekly market
markets.description: Browse local market stalls; verify current location and operating day.

markets.name: Nerja shops
markets.description: Explore small boutiques, bakeries and souvenir shops in the old town.

markets.name: Frigiliana artisan shops
markets.description: Browse crafts and local products in the village.

markets.name: Local supermarkets
markets.description: Pick up essentials around town; check Sunday opening hours.

nightlife.name: Plaza Tutti Frutti
nightlife.description: Area known for bars and evening venues; check current openings.

nightlife.name: Old Town tapas bars
nightlife.description: Enjoy a relaxed evening in the streets near the centre.

nightlife.name: Balcón de Europa promenade
nightlife.description: Evening stroll with sea views and nearby cafés.

nightlife.name: Burriana beachfront
nightlife.description: Beachside dining and bars, especially in the main holiday season.

family.name: Nerja Caves
family.description: Family cave visit; check accessibility and any age guidance.

family.name: Burriana Beach
family.description: Beach day with facilities and food options.

family.name: Boat or kayak excursions
family.description: Look for licensed operators and check sea conditions.

family.name: Frigiliana day out
family.description: Explore village viewpoints; note steep streets and steps.

family.name: Coastal walks
family.description: Choose suitable stretches and take water and sun protection.

dining.name: Old Town tapas
dining.description: Find traditional tapas bars and restaurants around central Nerja.

dining.name: Burriana chiringuitos
dining.description: Beachfront restaurants, including local fish and rice dishes.

dining.name: Balcón de Europa area
dining.description: Cafés and restaurants close to the seafront viewpoint.

dining.name: Frigiliana restaurants
dining.description: Village cafés and Andalusian food with hillside views.

dining.name: Maro village
dining.description: Smaller local eateries; check opening days before travelling.

daytrips.name: Frigiliana
daytrips.description: Whitewashed hill village a short journey inland from Nerja.

daytrips.name: Maro and the Nerja Caves
daytrips.description: Combine a cave visit with the village or nearby coast.

daytrips.name: Málaga
daytrips.description: Museums, historic sites and harbour; check intercity transport.

daytrips.name: Almuñécar
daytrips.description: Coastal town to the east with beaches and an old quarter.

daytrips.name: Cómpeta
daytrips.description: Mountain village in the Axarquía region; winding roads.

daytrips.name: Granada
daytrips.description: Longer day trip for historic sights; plan travel and tickets carefully.
